name: Lobb
what: An Android app that sends photos, videos and files directly from one phone to another over Wi-Fi Direct, with no internet, account or server.
hard_part: The transfer engine is raw TCP written in Kotlin so bytes never cross into Dart: a JSON manifest up front, then 4 MB chunks pipelined with no per-file round trips and a CRC32 check per chunk, so a dropped link resumes from the last good chunk instead of restarting.
status: Built, verified on emulators · not yet on Play
facts: 178 MB/s in an on-device loopback self-test (300 MB + 200 files, every byte checked)
166 MB/s with a forced link drop, resumed by itself
1.64 GB at 171 MB/s between two emulators
